description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $60-$100 per hour 
 
 Ability to commit at least 20 hours per week .
 Availability to work consistently on weekdays.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
 Ability to independently develop, review, and validate complex CAD models and mechanical engineering solutions.
 Attention to detail when evaluating geometric accuracy, dimensions, tolerances, and manufacturing feasibility.
 Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams comprising mechanical engineers, CAD specialists, and AI researchers.
 
 Join a leading AI lab's cutting-edge Generative AI team and contribute to developing and improving foundational AI models from the ground up. We are seeking experienced Mechanical Design Engineers and CAD Specialists with strong hands-on expertise in mechanical engineering, parametric CAD modeling, 3D design, and product development.
 In this role, you will leverage your real-world engineering experience to help train and evaluate advanced AI models by developing complex mechanical design tasks, validating CAD-generated solutions, and providing expert-level technical feedback.
 Your expertise will contribute to improving AI capabilities in mechanical design, 3D modeling, engineering drawings, geometric accuracy, design intent, and design for manufacturing (DFM).
 This is a W-2 employment opportunity with the potential to work with a leading AI research lab as part of its extended engineering workforce.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Improve AI Model Performance: Guide AI research and engineering teams in identifying technical knowledge gaps and improving model capabilities across mechanical design, CAD engineering, parametric modeling, and product development.
 Develop Technical Tasks: Design challenging, real-world mechanical engineering and CAD problems, and create accurate, well-documented reference solutions.
 Evaluate AI-Generated Designs: Review AI-generated CAD models, engineering drawings, and mechanical design solutions for dimensional accuracy, geometric consistency, design intent, and engineering feasibility.
 Create CAD Modeling Benchmarks: Develop and evaluate practical CAD assignments involving 3D part modeling, assemblies, surface modeling, sheet metal design, and complex mechanical components.
 Validate Engineering Drawings: Assess technical drawings, dimensions, tolerances, geometric specifications, and manufacturing requirements.
 Evaluate Design for Manufacturing: Review mechanical designs for manufacturability, material selection, assembly feasibility, production efficiency, and cost optimization.
 Develop Evaluation Frameworks: Establish technical rubrics to assess geometric accuracy, parametric modeling quality, GD&T compliance, engineering standards, and design robustness.
 Provide Expert Technical Feedback: Identify errors, inconsistencies, and design limitations in AI-generated models and provide clear, actionable recommendations.
 Collaborate with AI Research Teams: Work alongside researchers, engineers, and other domain experts to ensure technical accuracy, consistency, and quality across AI training datasets.
 Core Qualifications
 4+ years of professional experience in Mechanical Design Engineering, CAD Engineering, Product Design, or Mechanical Development.
 Strong hands-on expertise in at least one or more industry-standard parametric CAD platforms:
 SolidWorks
 CATIA
 Siemens NX
 PTC Creo
 Autodesk Fusion 360
 Onshape
 Advanced understanding of parametric 3D modeling, feature-based design, part modeling, assembly design, and complex geometric modeling.
 Working knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T), engineering drawings, dimensional tolerances, and technical documentation.
 Strong understanding of Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), material selection, and manufacturing processes.
 Experience creating and validating complex mechanical components, assemblies, and production-ready engineering designs.
 Ability to interpret engineering specifications, technical drawings, and product requirements and translate them into accurate CAD models.
 Understanding of mechanical engineering fundamentals, including materials, mechanisms, fits, clearances, and structural considerations.
 Experience working in established engineering, product development, manufacturing, or industrial design organizations is preferred.
 Demonstrable career progression and experience handling complex mechanical design challenges.
 Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and engineering decisions clearly.
 
 Ideal Candidate Profile
 The ideal candidate is an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with strong practical expertise in SolidWorks, CATIA, Siemens NX, or similar professional CAD platforms.
 You should have hands-on experience developing production-ready mechanical designs, working with complex 3D models and assemblies, interpreting engineering drawings, and applying manufacturing and engineering principles to real-world design challenges.
